Title: Semantic Search Gap
Content: MemorySmith now has an optional ONNX embedding path for memory semantic search, but the remaining gap is a durable vector index. When SemanticSearch model and WordPiece vocabulary assets are available, SemanticEmbeddingSearchService ranks filtered memories by exact in-memory cosine similarity; when assets are missing or unusable, MemoryApplicationService falls back to local token, tag, title, reference, and alias scoring. Hybrid search fuses Lucene.NET lexical rank with whichever semantic ranker is active through RRF. A more general large-KB tool still needs cached/durable vector indexing, page embeddings, model asset validation, and a migration path that does not force PostgreSQL before the product needs it.
